text:
The known port disable/enable workaround does not apply to TRN-077 because firmware 3.4.0 already fixes stuck forwarding after an SFP replacement, so the cause is likely something else.

1. Contact an expert for further troubleshooting on this firmware version.

**What did not work:**
- Rebooting the unit failed to restore traffic counters on TRN-015 (Mikko Mäkelä, teams, 2025-06-30).
- Replacing the SFP again failed to restore traffic on TRN-031 (Tiina Tuominen, teams, 2025-07-15).

This firmware behavior is moderately confident (0.7) from Erkki Expert (email, 2026-04-08).
